summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload under fetched Bun runtime
details: tslint-folder-schema@1.0.11 declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the zip, chmod +x's the binary, and executes a bundled sibling `math_init.js` under Bun via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')])`. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotated numeric string-array dispatcher, mangled identifiers) that Node's tooling will not naturally inspect. The package advertises itself as a TSLint folder-schema rule and links homepage `https://github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint`, purposes that have no need for the Bun runtime or a large opaque payload. Installing the package therefore runs an opaque attacker-controlled program on the installer's host at `npm install` time, executed under a runtime fetched specifically to evade Node-based inspection. The mismatch between the advertised TSLint helper identity and the shipped preinstall dropper is consistent with brand-abuse of servicetitan/folder-lint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
